purpose: Upload and verify exactly the 119 pinned keys (raw 58, derived v2 61). No other key, bucket or operation.
job_caps_note: All runs of this job together, including the usage recorded before the ledger existed (ledger seq 1). Sized for one upload run and two full verification rounds (verify-copy raw, verify-copy derived, verify, reproduce = 4 verify runs each). Pinned bytes: raw 84,672,102 + derived 19,611,663 = 104,283,765.
run_profiles_note: A run reserves its profile in full before any request. When it finishes it records what it measured (never more than reserved) and only that counts; a run that crashes or never settles keeps its whole reservation. verify reserves 16 KiB of uploads for its two ledger records; any upload is still limited to the pinned keys with their exact bytes. status reads the ledger (up to 2 x max_ledger_records GETs).
